entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Story0BeginningDescription
entry.value: Gladus Prime was supposed to be one of the first worlds of New Mankind — rich in resources and strategically important. But planet's warp storms cut off our fleet, and we found ourselves trapped on the planet’s surface. Orks, xenos, Imperial punitive forces—they all want to wipe us off the face of this world. We survived, but barely: our supplies are running out, our equipment is destroyed, and our people are terrified. We need to gain a foothold. We need to build factories, rally scattered units, and prove that New Humanity is more than just words. Let’s start small. With one city. With one victory.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Story0Stage0Description
entry.value: Before we can defend ourselves, we must learn to manufacture weapons. We need a manufacturing facility—the heart of our defense industry. Find a suitable location and lay the foundation for our future arsenal.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Story0Stage1Description
entry.value: The Manufactorium is ready, but without scouting we’re blind. Assemble a scout unit from what’s left of the Imperial warehouses. This walker will comb the wastelands, find resources, and warn us of approaching enemies. We must find defectors, loot, and cover before the enemy does.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Story0Stage2Description
entry.value: A sentry has spotted traces of wild xenos—the Kroot—who hunt humans in the wastelands. These aren’t just beasts. They’re the remnants of an army that the Imperium abandoned here to die. They pose a danger to our scouts and defectors. Eliminate them before they become a threat to the city.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Story0EndingDescription
entry.value: We’ve built a city, set up production, and cleared the surrounding area of threats. It’s a small victory, but it gives us breathing room. Now we have a base from which to move forward. A long war lies ahead, but now we have a chance. Gladius Prime won’t be our graveyard—it will be our home... The New Mankind begins here!
